thread:
Maya K: hey @people-ops — sending this as a thread because it's confidential. i recently returned from parental leave and i'm still dealing with postpartum depression. i'm trying to avoid a formal escalation but need accommodations ahead of performance reviews: 1) a 3-month extension on my review window, 2) reduced on-call (1 week/month instead of rotating), and 3) access to a private lactation/pumping room schedule onsite. can someone advise next steps?

Jonas M: Maya — thank you for sharing, and i'm here to support. if you're comfortable, i'd like to be kept in the loop so we can adjust project expectations. but totally ok if you want people-ops/HR to manage this confidentially first. :heart:

Elaine - People Ops: hi Maya — i'm sorry you're going through this. we can absolutely handle this discretely. basics: we start the ADA/interactive process, discuss temporary adjustments, and document agreed accommodations. nothing goes into your performance file beyond what you consent to share. can we DM to set a 30m check-in?

Maya K: thanks Elaine. i'd prefer people-ops + HR initial call and limited manager visibility (high-level only). DM works. i'd like to avoid anything that reads like a 'negative' note in my review.

Priya - HR: Maya — we can do that. typical options: note from provider (if you have one) to support accommodations, a written accommodation plan with start/end dates, and temporary adjustments to goals/oncall. we can also propose a review deferral or reweighting of Q3 objectives. we'll keep manager notes minimal and factual.

Devon: just adding — engineering can cover extra oncall weeks if needed. happy to help coordinate schedules.

Elaine - People Ops: proposed quick template we can use (we'll tweak on the call):

```
Accommodation plan (draft):
- Scope: reduced on-call to 1 week/month for 3 months
- Review timeline: extend current performance evaluation by 3 months
- Workload: temporarily pause non-critical project deadlines; re-prioritize OKRs
- Privacy: limited disclosure to direct manager (status-only) and HR/People Ops
- Documentation: provider note optional but helpful; HR will retain confidential file
```

Elaine - People Ops: if that sounds ok we'll schedule the call and produce the plan. if you want to keep manager awareness minimal, say so on the call and we'll handle communication.

Maya K: that template looks good. i don't have a provider note right now but can send one later if needed. DM me times pls.

Jonas M: understood. Maya, if it helps i can explicitly sign up to cover any hotfixes while you're on reduced oncall. no public message about performance.

Priya - HR: next steps: 1) 30m private call this week, 2) draft accommodation plan, 3) implement oncall rota changes and extend review window in our HR system. i'll generate the formal doc and mark it confidential.

Maya K: thank you everyone. really appreciate the support. i'll take the call tomorrow morning.

Elaine - People Ops: sending DM now to lock time. we'll follow up in-thread only for logistics; all health details stay in the private HR record. :lock:
